migrationDrift.defectFound: The migration was not merely interrupted. Its refresh function declared a plpgsql variable named started_at, which collides with sync_runs.started_at in the ORDER BY of the recent-runs subquery. Since the migration ends by calling that function, it would have failed on every apply regardless of disk space. Renamed the variable to fn_started_at.

postApplyVerification.note: Row counts identical to the pre-apply baseline; RLS stayed at 100% coverage. One INFO advisor (rls_enabled_no_policy) is intentional: the snapshot table is server-only, so no policy means deny-all for clients while service_role bypasses RLS.

v3LiveVerification.serverOnlyPolicyNote: RLS enabled with no policy is the intended deny-all for tables that grant nothing to anon/authenticated. Only the six client-readable V3 tables carry published/verified read policies.
